title: Compare two feature sets
description: Course activity for Exercise II: configure two linear-regression models that predict full-scale IQ from FreeSurfer brain morphometry, changing the measurement type and the anatomical ROI bundle, and compare their cross-validated performance side by side on one fixed cohort and one fixed set of folds.
instructions: Set a measurement type and an ROI bundle for Model A and for Model B. Each panel shows observed vs out-of-fold predicted IQ with a perfect-prediction diagonal, the cross-validated R-squared and MSE, and the feature count. The cohort and the folds are identical for every configuration, so any difference you see is a real difference between the feature sets.
literatureNote: The Parieto-Frontal Integration Theory (Jung & Haier, 2007, doi:10.1017/S0140525X07001185) and Narr et al.'s cortical-thickness work (2007, doi:10.1093/cercor/bhl125) point to dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, the inferior and superior parietal lobules and the intraparietal sulcus, and dorsal anterior cingulate as the cortex most often linked to intelligence. The frontoparietal bundle maps those regions onto the HCP-MMP1 (Glasser) atlas labels used here. This is a hypothesis about which features to try first - it is not a promise that those features will predict IQ in this sample, and it does not make a better-scoring bundle biologically causal.
selectionBiasNote: Trying many configurations here is exploratory model comparison. If you pick the best-looking one and report its cross-validated R-squared as the model's performance, that number is optimistic: you chose it because it looked good on this very data. An honest final estimate needs a locked-away test set or a nested procedure.
reflectionPrompts: Hold the ROI bundle fixed and change only the measurement type. Then hold the measurement type fixed and change only the bundle. Which control moves R-squared more?
Compare the frontoparietal bundle with a similarly sized comparison bundle using the same measurement type. Does the literature-motivated bundle predict IQ better here?
Set one model to 'All eligible ROIs'. What happens to the feature count and to R-squared, and why?
